Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday — excited to move the MSA + order form live. As we start consolidating redlines I wanted to confirm a few items tied to the publicity/confidentiality sections so Legal can finalize language quickly:

1) Embargo window: are you asking for an embargo from customer-side until BrightCo public announcement, or do you want a fixed window post-launch (e.g., 30 days)?
2) PR approver: who at BrightCo will be the designated approver for customer quotes / case study language (name + email)?
3) Logo usage: please send the high-res logo files and any brand guidelines we must follow (format, attribution, color/clear space).
4) Evidence & audit: procurement asked for an evidence plan — if we include a clause requiring logo asset escrow and an approval turn-around time (48-72h), will that work?

I've attached our current order form redline to make the asks concrete: orderform_redline_v2.pdf (redline PDF).

If you prefer, Kimberly (cc'd) can propose concrete alternate language and we can cycle that back to your legal team. Goal: lock publicity + confidentiality clauses this week so procurement can schedule signature.

Thanks —

Hi Ben,

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers before we review your redline:

- Embargo: BrightCo typically prefers a firm embargo tied to our public announcement date, but we can accept a 30-day post-launch window if you need predictable timing. If possible, we prefer right-of-first-announcement language (i.e., we announce first).
- PR approver: Our comms lead is Clara Yu (clara.yu@brightco.com). For legal sign-off on copy the contact is BrightCo Legal (legal@brightco.com).
- Logo assets & guidelines: attaching our brand guide and logo package. See BrightCo_logo_guidelines.pdf — note: monochrome usage only allowed for press quotes, color versions require separate permission.
- Approval SLA: 72 hours turnaround for standard testimonial copy is doable; for press release quotes we usually require 5 business days.

I'll ask legal to review any proposed language Kimberly sends. For the evidence request: we can deliver a signed orderform + a single high-res logo package; we typically do not do long-term asset escrow for logos, but can include a clause that requires delivery of assets on execution.

Onward —
Sara
Sara Lim
Director, Strategic Partnerships | BrightCo

Hi all —

Thanks for the details, Sara. I reviewed the redline and BrightCo brand guide; attached is a short set of proposed edits that aim to: (a) preserve BrightCo's control over brand use, (b) keep Redwood's ability to reference the customer for case studies, and (c) set clear SLAs to avoid slow approvals. High-level summary of suggested language:

- Confidentiality carveout (customer reference): Add a limited carveout that permits Redwood to identify BrightCo as a customer for marketing and case studies, provided any direct quotations or logos are pre-approved in writing. Approval to be provided within 5 business days for press releases and 72 hours for testimonial snippets; approvals shall not be unreasonably withheld.

- Embargo & announcement sequencing: Option A (preferred by BrightCo) — right-of-first-announcement language that respects BrightCo's announcement date. Option B — a 30-day post-launch window if BrightCo cannot commit to a date. Either option should be clearly enumerated in the order form.

- Logo use & asset delivery: Require delivery of a single high-res logo package on execution (acceptable formats: .svg, .png 300dpi) and usage limited to the scope in the order form. For any co-branded marketing beyond a short testimonial, require a separate asset approval flow.

- Evidence / audit trail: Add a short clause obligating both parties to maintain approval emails and usage screenshots for 12 months following first public use for potential audit requests. This satisfies procurement without creating an operational escrow burden.

- Acceptance criteria: Insert a one-sentence fallback that, if the parties cannot agree on final wording for testimonial approval timelines, the default shall be 5 business days for press and 72 hours for short testimonial copy.

I've attached a redline with inline edits: redline_suggestions_orderform.pdf. If BrightCo legal agrees, we can incorporate these edits into orderform_redline_v2.pdf and send a final for signature.

Notes / open items for BrightCo legal: please confirm whether BrightCo requires a separate trademark license for whitepaper/case-study PDFs (we've seen this vary). Also confirm whether monochrome-only constraints apply to logo usage on our hosted docs (we may need a license exception).

Best —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_suggestions_orderform.pdf (application/pdf)
